name: Ejercicio 9

on:
  push:

jobs:
  install-dependencies:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      max-parallel: 2
      matrix:
        node: [20, 22, 24]

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}

      - name: install npm
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm test
          npm run build
